title: DECISION: signing key file readable check at startup not request time
description: config.rs validate() calls std::fs::metadata() on operator.signing_key_path if it is set, and the comment explains the intent: 'Better to catch this at startup than discover it when an article arrives.' A missing or unreadable signing key at article time causes silent article loss (pipeline error) rather than a clear startup failure. Checking at startup converts a runtime failure-mode into a configuration error caught before any traffic is processed.
